mostWorthwhile.text: Recycling rain that returned as steam made the movement of the same water between phases clear, and set up the eventual lasting rain.

leastWorthwhile.text: The sequence of only-offered combinations became somewhat repetitive after the rain returned as steam.

surprise.text: Rain could fall yet evaporate or boil rather than form a lasting pool; clouds and rainfall alone do not establish a sea.

arbitrary.text: Sending rain to a still-hot volcanic surface felt confusing after I had already created ground cool enough to retain water. The later distinction between surfaces was not clear at first.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the first persistent water accumulates into a sea, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than the final linear sequence offered.
